description_en: Queries the details of a knowledge base synchronization link
description_zh: 查询知识库同步链路详情
name: DescribeKBSyncLinkAttribute

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the knowledge base
parameters.name: knowledge_base_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the synchronization link
parameters.name: link_id

schema.description_en: The response for querying the details of a knowledge base synchronization link
schema.description_zh: 查询知识库同步链路详情的返回结果

ClientId.description_en: The client ID of the source application

Config.description_en: The synchronization configuration whitelist returned based on the source type. For DINGTALK, UserId can be returned. For FEISHU, FeishuChatMemberStaleTtlSeconds can be returned
Config.description_zh: 按来源类型返回的同步配置白名单。DINGTALK 可返回 UserId，FEISHU 可返回 FeishuChatMemberStaleTtlSeconds

FeishuChatMemberStaleTtlSeconds.description_en: The validity period of the successful snapshot of Lark group members for fallback reuse, in seconds. This parameter is returned only for FEISHU synchronization links. A value of -1 indicates that the snapshot never expires. A value of 0 indicates that snapshot fallback reuse is disabled. A positive integer indicates the maximum age of the snapshot allowed for reuse. The valid value configured for the link is returned. If no value is configured, the default value -1 is returned
FeishuChatMemberStaleTtlSeconds.description_zh: 飞书群成员成功快照用于降级复用的有效期，单位为秒。仅 FEISHU 同步链路返回；-1 表示永不过期，0 表示禁用快照降级复用，正整数表示允许复用的快照最大年龄；返回链路配置的有效值，未配置时返回默认值 -1
FeishuChatMemberStaleTtlSeconds.title_en: 飞书群成员成功快照用于降级复用的有效期，单位为秒。仅 FEISHU 同步链路返回；-1 表示永不过期，0 表示禁用快照降级复用，正整数表示允许复用的快照最大年龄；返回链路配置的有效值，未配置时返回默认值 -1
FeishuChatMemberStaleTtlSeconds.title_zh: 飞书群成员成功快照用于降级复用的有效期，单位为秒。仅 FEISHU 同步链路返回；-1 表示永不过期，0 表示禁用快照降级复用，正整数表示允许复用的快照最大年龄；返回链路配置的有效值，未配置时返回默认值 -1

UserId.description_en: The ID of the DingTalk user who performs the operation. This parameter is returned only for DINGTALK synchronization links
UserId.description_zh: 钉钉操作用户 ID，仅 DINGTALK 同步链路返回
